_comment: PA1 PII linter hook for Cursor.
Install: copy this file to ~/.cursor/hooks.json (user-wide) or
.cursor/hooks.json (per-project) and merge with your existing config.
postToolUse: after Cursor writes/edits a file, scan it. Exit 2 on HIGH+
so Cursor surfaces the failure to the model and asks it to fix.
stop:        at end-of-turn, scan the staged diff. Exit 2 to force
Cursor to continue and clean up before signing off.
Cursor passes the affected file path via stdin JSON (key: file_path) —
the hook script extracts it with a small jq/python one-liner.

hooks.command: bash -c 'p=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"file_path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); case "$p" in *.csv|*.jsonl|*.md) pa1-lint scan -- "$p" || exit 2;; esac'
